_howto: Add one object to 'events' per talk or award. type: talk | award-received | award-presented. date: YYYY-MM-DD. image: website/images/events/<file>.jpg (about 1600px wide, under 250 KB; it is cropped to 16:9, use imagePos e.g. '50% 30%' to keep faces in view). link is optional: an article on this site (news/<page>.html) or an outside page (opens in a new tab). Set placeholder to false for real events. A night with several awards can have a full article: add it to 'stories' (id, title, summary, date, image, url) and give each of that night's events story: '<story id>'. The newest story is featured at the top of News & events and on Home and About.

stories.title: Goddiva named Retailer Tech Innovator of the Year at the Drapers Awards 2026
stories.summary: One night after its Boutique Star Awards win, Goddiva took home a second tech award. Co-founders Kuganeswaran Thangarajah and Mina Melikova collected it in London.
stories.imageAlt: Kuganeswaran Thangarajah and Mina Melikova holding the Drapers Awards 2026 trophy

stories.title: Two awards presented, two brought home: our night at the Boutique Star Awards 2026
stories.summary: Boutique Magazine invited our founder, Kuganeswaran Thangarajah, to present two of the night’s awards. Goddiva, the fashion brand he founded, took home two more.
